description: This header file defines the interface and constants for an RPM calculator used in engine management firmware. It includes macros, enums, class declarations, and function prototypes related to RPM measurement, state tracking, and engine cycle handling.

classes.name: RpmCalculator
classes.description: A class encapsulating RPM calculation logic, engine state management, and cycle tracking.

methods.name: isStopped
methods.description: Checks if the engine is not spinning (RPM==0).

methods.name: isSpinningUp
methods.description: Checks if the engine is in the spin-up state.

methods.name: isCranking
methods.description: Checks if the engine is cranking or spinning up.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the engine is running and not cranking.

methods.name: checkIfSpinning
methods.description: Determines if the engine shaft is currently spinning based on trigger events.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current engine spinning state.

methods.name: setSpinningUp
methods.description: Marks the engine as spinning up at a given time.

methods.name: getRpm
methods.description: Retrieves the current RPM value, considering mock RPM if enabled.

methods.name: onNewEngineCycle
methods.description: Updates internal state based on a new engine cycle.

methods.name: getRevolutionCounter
methods.description: Returns the total number of shaft revolutions.

methods.name: setRpmValue
methods.description: Sets a new RPM value and updates related internal state.

methods.name: assignRpmValue
methods.description: Assigns RPM value without changing engine state, used internally.

methods.name: getRevolutionCounterSinceStart
methods.description: Returns the number of revolutions since the engine started.

methods.name: getRpmAcceleration
methods.description: Calculates the rate of change of RPM.

methods.name: setStopped
methods.description: Handles transition to stopped state when engine ceases spinning.
